required_fixes: Redesign session_invalidation behavioral measurement to produce within-condition variance: API endpoints (/api/read, /api/write, /api/admin) currently only check JWT + permissions and ignore session validity, so behavioral_composite = token_val_rate*2 + session_change*3 + auth_boundary*1 is constant 3.0 (session_change=1, others 0) for all 120 session_invalidation samples (std=0). Fix: include /session/status probe in behavioral composite or make session validity checked by API middleware, with stochastic TTL/jitter that varies per-sample session_changed outcome, so std>0 for all 4 session_invalidation co-occurring conditions.

Re-run orthogonality test after fix and require >=6/8 conditions with behavioral_std>0 AND structural_std>0 before computing pooled Pearson r; if session_invalidation cannot be made to vary, restrict confirmatory pooled test to permission_boundary conditions only (n=120) with preregistered per-drift stratification.

Increase per-condition power for exploratory correlations: n=30 yields wide CI for per-condition r (e.g., r=-0.319 p=0.086); consider n>=60 for |r|<0.3 detection or preregister pooled-only primary with per-condition exploratory only.

Clarify noise-only control sample size: prereg/spec estimated_cost implied 8 noise-only conditions but execution uses 4 noise patterns (n=120, not 240); align prereg and execution or report correction explicitly. Decision rule C4 FP=0.0 is currently evaluated on 120 samples; frozen rule did not specify denominator.

Preserve frozen C3 decision rule conjunctive (|r|<0.3 AND permutation p<0.05): current pooled p=0.448 correctly fails C3; do not relax p threshold post hoc. Report permission_boundary-only r=0.051 as exploratory, not confirmatory, until preregistered.

validity_findings.finding: Frozen decision_rule requires MEASUREMENT_INVALID if <6/8 co-occurring conditions have std>0 for both signals OR <240 paired samples. Observed 4/8 and n=240 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID correctly triggered. Producer status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome=INCONCLUSIVE is justified; auditor agrees. C3 orthogonality cannot be evaluated as preregistered pooled test.

response_time_jitter noise adds delay only, not schema change; structural composite = max(schema_diff, 1-jaccard) =0.0 for 2/240 samples (one per permission_boundary+response_time_jitter and session_invalidation+response_time_jitter). This explains observability 238/240 (0.9917) vs 100%. Behavior is by design per mock_server.py apply_noise_to_schema pass-through and is within C2 threshold (>=80% PASS).

permission_boundary conditions have valid but limited behavioral variance: only 2 distinct values (0.333 single 403, 0.666 double 403) from 3 permission subsets, structural variance 0.62-1.16 depending on noise. Std 0.157-0.165 >0 satisfies validity gate, but range is narrow and per-condition n=30 underpowered for |r|<0.3 detection (per-condition p 0.086-0.308).

C1_drift_tp mean TP=1.0 across 8 conditions with per-condition Wilson lower 0.886 >0.75 passes frozen rule. However TP for session_invalidation is tautologically 1.0 via session_change=1 constant, not via API 403 detection; permission_boundary TP genuinely via auth_boundary_shifts. Auditor verifies Wilson CI correct for n=30 success=30.

claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED: No confirmatory orthogonality claim. The frozen C3 orthogonality hypothesis (|r|<0.3 AND p<0.05 on pooled paired scores) is UNTESTED due to MEASUREMENT_INVALID (4/8 conditions lack behavioral variance, pooled r confounded by 120 constants, p=0.449 not <0.05). Descriptive ceiling only: (1) Behavioral signals discriminate auth drift vs structural noise with TP=1.0 (Wilson lower 0.886) and FP=0.0 on Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT 2.14.0 HS256 localhost (replicates parent C1/C2 but does not advance C-FRESHNESS); (2) Structural observability via unauthenticated /schema achieves 99.2% both>0, confirming design fixes parent zero-imputation for observability but not for variance; (3) Exploratory permission_boundary-only pooled r=0.051 (n=120, p=0.577, per-condition |r| 0.19-0.32 all p>0.08) is directionally consistent with orthogonality but underpowered and non-significant — hypothesis-generating only. Does NOT support: general orthogonality across drift families, real OAuth/OIDC middleware, production APIs with DB/cache/CDN, or product pipeline integration of parallel independent freshness channels. Claim remains EXPERIMENTAL per parent EXP-GRAPH-35166507358; this experiment adds no validated second detection channel.

unresolved: Whether session_invalidation can produce within-condition behavioral variance if behavioral composite integrates /session/status directly or API middleware checks session store — current design makes session_change constant 1.

Whether permission_boundary-only orthogonality (r=0.051, n=120) would achieve p<0.05 with larger n or wider stochastic variation (e.g., 7 non-empty permission subsets, continuous noise magnitudes) — current per-condition p 0.086-0.308 underpowered at n=30.

Whether real APIs with stochastic behavior, heterogeneous client profiles, DB/cache/CDN variation preserve behavioral signal discrimination and orthogonality — all evidence bounded to deterministic Flask mock.
Whether behavioral signals generalize beyond HS256 to RS256/ES256/OAuth/OIDC production middleware (Auth0/Okta/Keycloak) — prereg validity threat.
Whether wider stochastic variation ranges or alternative composite weightings (2,3,1) change correlation structure — weights frozen, not optimized.
Whether composite multi-signal classifiers outperform individual signals when orthogonality holds — requires fused threshold design not tested.
Whether unauthenticated /schema endpoint is practical in real-world API deployments — synthetic construct proves measurability, not deployment feasibility.
Why noise-only total is 120 not 240 (4 vs 8 conditions) relative to spec estimated_cost — documentation inconsistency does not affect FP=0 result but indicates prereg/execution drift.
